# Read Primitives — String Concatenation

```{tags} reference, query-template, read_primitives
```

> [Read Primitives](../../read-primitives.md) benchmark · [all Read Primitives queries](index.md)

String concatenation

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
/* String concatenation */ SELECT c_custkey, c_name || ' - ' || c_mktsegment AS customer_info FROM customer LIMIT 100
```

## Representative DataFrame

Expression family (Polars, PySpark, DataFusion), default parameters.

```python
def string_concat_expression_impl(ctx: DataFrameContext) -> Any:
    """String concatenation."""
    col, lit = ctx.col, ctx.lit
    return (
        ctx.get_table("customer")
        .select(col("c_custkey"), (col("c_name") + lit(" - ") + col("c_mktsegment")).alias("customer_info"))
        .limit(100)
    )
```
